'''Frostnip''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Frostpaw]] at 3 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Frostnip may look cool and aloof, but the truth is, opening that mouth lets all the cold air out."

Frostnip is a purple rarity Tatari. 

==Appearance==
Frostnip is a small, cat-like Tatari. Its body is made out of an ice cube. It has a large, round head with white fur, and a dark blue mask-like marking around its eyes. It has large, light blue eyes. Its ears are pointed upright and dark blue. It has small, blue paws, and a short dark blue tail to match.

Frostnip's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with gold.

==Evolution Trial==
Frostnip's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 3 bronze stars/6 copies. To evolve it into [[Frostpaw]] you need to complete the following task:

* Defeat 300 Zobos while clearing stages.

== Trivia ==

* Frostnips bio used to say: "Its daily mission is to know every glass of water in the camp off the table. Why? No reason."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "When Frostnip was first discovered, the Internet Meme School of Tatari Studies immediately proposed the theory that cats are not liquid. Soon after, researchers within t6he same school countered, asking how a cat could freeze if it were not liquid. The debate did not truly end until scholars identified Frostnip's dual solid liquid nature, which finally brought the controversy to a close."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26, its bio description said: "Sensitive to heat, Frostnip melts under direct sunlight but can glide smoothly over frozen lake surfaces in winter."

==Strategy==
[[File:Frostnip Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Frostnip's attack range]]
Surprisingly good Water DPS. Paired with a [[Waddledo]]/evo and a [[Sealing]]/evo, can create a powerful Water lane.
